title: Common finite continuous matrix and ordinary scalar compatibility
statement: Fix a finite intermediate field E of the norm-topological algebraic closure of Q_ell, the all-continuous rings [def-sfb-kummer-coefficient-models], two finite continuous E-representations with their condensations [def-sfb-finite-continuous-kummer-coefficient-model], and four normalized field charts on the same actual full Kummer tower [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-chart]. For a given puncture morphism, a simultaneous scalar-compatible morphism specification retains its actual chart morphisms over E and over the closure [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-morphism], the unique-extension properties over both fields, one continuous equivariant E-linear matrix, and the two condensation equations saying that both boundary arrows are given by that same matrix. It further retains actual ordinary scalar-extension isomorphisms between the two extensions, normalized on the puncture by the canonical inverse-image/scalar-extension comparison, and their naturality equation for the actual extended morphism. Rank zero, unequal ranks, and arbitrary profinite families are included. The specification makes no existence assertion and does not commute scalar extension with direct image.
